transcript.content: Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

"Hi Sky, thank you for answering. I'm calling because I'm planning a trip to Athens soon and I'm interested in knowing about the wheelchair assistance options available on your flights. I use a wheelchair due to mobility issues and need help getting to my seat from check-in to departure."
I can certainly help you with that. To provide you with the most accurate information, I'll need to look up our special assistance policies regarding wheelchairs. Please give me a moment.

"Okay, that sounds great, thank you for checking on that. Just to confirm, I'm looking for information on how to request wheelchair assistance for my flight from [current city] to Athens, and what kind of support I can expect once I get to the airport?"

Based on your needs, it sounds like you would require "Wheelchair to seat" assistance, coded as WCHS. This means you would receive assistance from check-in all the way to your seat on the aircraft, as you mentioned needing help getting to your seat from check-in to departure.

To arrange this, special assistance must be requested at least 48 hours before your flight's departure. This service is provided free of charge. Passengers requiring reduced mobility assistance are also pre-assigned suitable seating.

Do you have an existing booking for your flight to Athens that I can add this assistance to, or are you looking to book a new flight?

"That sounds good to know, thank you. I actually don't have an existing booking yet, but I'm planning on flying out within the next week. Can you confirm that the WCHS assistance will be available for flights departing within the next 48 hours?"

I understand you're looking to fly within the next week. However, special assistance, including WCHS, needs to be requested at least 48 hours before departure. This means if you book a flight departing within the next 48 hours, we may not be able to guarantee the WCHS assistance.

Would you like me to help you search for flights to Athens for dates that allow for the 48-hour notice period for special assistance?

"Yes, that would be helpful. I'm flexible with my travel dates, so please go ahead and show me some options that are available within the next week or so. Can you also confirm whether there's a specific process or deadline to request the WCHS assistance once I've found a flight?"

Here are some of the cheapest flight options to Athens within the next week:

   Flight AX202, departing on May 16th at 6:00 PM, arriving at 9:45 PM, for £199 in economy class.
   Flight AX298, departing on May 17th at 6:30 AM, arriving at 10:15 AM, for £199 in economy class.
   Flight AX406, departing on May 18th at 6:30 AM, arriving at 10:15 AM, for £199 in economy class.

Regarding the WCHS assistance, once you have booked your flight, you will need to request the assistance at least 48 hours before your scheduled departure time. You can do this when you book the flight online, or by contacting our accessibility team. If you book a flight with me, I can add the assistance for you after the booking is confirmed.

Do any of these flights interest you, or would you like to explore other dates or times?
"I'd like to book one of those flights, please. Can you help me with flight AX406 on May 18th at 6:30 AM? I'll also need to request the WCHS assistance for that flight."

Great choice! Flight AX406 departs on May 18th at 6:30 AM to Athens, and the price is £199 in economy class.

To book this flight for you, I'll need your full name and email address. Also, do you have any seat preference, such as a window or aisle seat?

"Thank you, Sky. My name is Emily Wilson, and my email address is emilywilson@email.com. I don't have a specific seat preference at this time, but I'll need to be seated near an accessible exit in case of an emergency."

Great news, Emily! Your flight AX406 to Athens on May 18th has been booked. Your booking reference is BK-A82A61. Please make a note of this reference for any future changes or inquiries.

The total price for your flight is £199. You will receive a booking confirmation email at emilywilson@email.com shortly, which will include a secure link for payment.

Now, regarding your WCHS assistance and your request for seating near an accessible exit, I will add the WCHS assistance to your booking. Sky Airways pre-assigns suitable seating for passengers with reduced mobility, so your request for a seat near an accessible exit will be taken into consideration when your seat is assigned.

Would you like me to proceed with adding the WCHS assistance to your booking BK-A82A61?

"Yes, please go ahead and add the WCHS assistance to my booking. I'm glad to hear that suitable seating will be pre-assigned for me. And thank you again for all your help with this. Is there anything else I need to know or take care of before we're done?"

evaluation.summary: Agent provided accurate information about wheelchair assistance options and booking process.
